batch.description: Jahangirnagar University A Unit (Mathematical & Physical Sciences), academic session 2017-2018, Set-6 — full 80-question paper transcribed by direct visual reading of the Udvash 'জাবি প্রশ্নব্যাংক' (JU A & D Unit question bank), book PDF pp.87-90 (questions), with the printed answer table ('উত্তরমালা') at the head of p.91 and printed worked solutions on pp.91-92. EXTRACTION STAGE: all questions are marked content-UNVERIFIED and all keyed answers answer-UNVERIFIED — the printed publisher answer keys are preserved as-is and are NOT official JU keys; cross-source verification is a later stage. The book prints NO per-subject headings in this paper (only a 'Short Syllabus' banner on p.87 and an 'Extra Syllabus' box on p.90, which holds Q26 and Q31); the printed question numbers are NOT grouped in subject blocks and are NOT in page order, so subjects are assigned strictly by question content: Bangla Q1-3 (3), English Q4-6 (3), General Knowledge Q7-14 (8), Physics Q15-27, 29-36 (21), Chemistry Q28, 37-58 (23), Higher Mathematics Q59-80 (22). No ICT questions occur in this paper. Page map (book PDF): p.87 carries Q1-18; p.88 carries Q19-25, 27-30, 34-43; p.89 carries Q44-46, 48-57, 59, 60, 62, 63, 65-69, 71; p.90 carries Q72-78 and, in its right column, Q32, 33, 47, 58, 61, 64, 70, 79, 80, plus Q26 and Q31 under the 'Extra Syllabus' box. The answer table prints exactly three dashes, at Q19, Q67 and Q76, and the printed worked solution for each of the three explicitly states '(সঠিক উত্তর নেই)' (no correct answer) and computes a value that is not among the printed options (Q19: W = 0.05 J; Q67: a = 2, -50; Q76: sin 3θ = 5/(3√3)) — so each carries answerDisposition 'no_correct_option' with correctOptionIds []; their answerVerificationStatus is 'verified' solely because the validator requires that status for a no_correct_option disposition — it records the book's own printed claim, not cross-source verification — while their contentVerificationStatus remains 'unverified' like every other question in this extraction-stage pack. No dual keys occur in this paper; all 77 keyed questions are single_choice. Worked solutions are printed for 42 questions (Short Syllabus: Q1-6, 15-19, 21, 24, 25, 30, 34, 43, 53, 56, 59, 60, 62, 63, 65-69, 71-78; Extra Syllabus: Q26, 32, 64, 70, 79, 80); every printed solution letter agrees with the answer table, and no table-vs-solution disagreement occurs. Preserved print anomalies: Q20(a)/(b) print negative exponents on the 10 (10^-2, 10^-3) against 10^3 in (c)/(d), and Q20(d) alone prints kgm^3; Q26(b) prints 'ওপেন হেইমার-ভলকফ সীমা'; Q30(a) prints 'ব্যাতিচার' for ব্যতিচার; Q34 prints the length symbol 'l' glyph-identical to the digit '1'; Q45(c)/(d) print stoichiometric coefficients as multipliers ('×3[B]', '×2[D]'); Q57's reaction prints '=' instead of an arrow; Q64 prints the vector as a barred 'ā'; Q79 prints set X in the unsorted order 2,5,6,3,9; Q80(b) prints the English word 'Nothing'. The scans crop the extreme right margin of the right-hand columns on pp.87 and 89, partly cutting line-final words in Q15-18 and Q63, Q65-67; those words are read from the visible letterforms, the sentence grammar and the book's own printed worked solutions, and each affected question carries an extractionNote saying so. No question in this paper is printed with a figure or diagram. IMPORT-READY SUBSET after cross-source adjudication vs Satt Academy: 53 of 80 questions verified. row 1: excluded (DIFFER) row 15: excluded (DIFFER) row 17: excluded (DIFFER) row 19: no-correct-option disposition corroborated row 24: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 32: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 33: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 34: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 35: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 36: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 37: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 38: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 39: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 40: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 41: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 44: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 45: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 51: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 54: excluded (DIFFER) row 63: excluded (DIFFER) row 65: excluded (DIFFER) row 67: no-correct-option disposition corroborated row 72: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 73: excluded (DIFFER) row 76: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 77: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 78: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 79: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC) row 80: excluded (NOT_PUBLIC)

sourceDocuments.title: Udvash জাবি প্রশ্নব্যাংক (JU A & D Unit question bank)
sourceDocuments.notes: Publisher question-bank book (Udvash Academic & Admission Care), scanned PDF, 295 pp. Set-6 of JU A Unit 2017-2018 occupies book PDF pp.87-92 (printed book pp.86-91): questions pp.87-90, printed answer table ('উত্তরমালা') at the head of p.91, printed worked solutions pp.91-92. Paper header (book PDF p.87) confirmed before transcription: জাবি ভর্তি পরীক্ষা ২০১৭-১৮ শিক্ষাবর্ষ, পূর্ণমান: ৮০, ইউনিট: A, সেট: 6, সময়: ৫৫ মিনিট. Transcription by direct visual reading of every page, with zoomed re-reads for the answer table, the Q59/Q60 matrices, the Q34 fraction options, the Q45 Kc options, the Q73/Q76 options and the right-margin-cropped lines on pp.87 and 89. Mathematical notation linearised (^ for superscripts, a/b for fractions, √, π, matrices wrapped in [[...], [...], [...]] with rows comma-separated, permutation/combination as ^nP_r / ^nC_r, unit vectors as î, ĵ, k̂ and vector arrows as →; chemical formulas written with plain digits for subscripts, e.g. N2O5, HSO4^-; nuclides linearised as ^<mass>_<atomic><symbol>, e.g. ^13_6C).

questions.extractionNote: Answer table prints a dash; printed solution states '(সঠিক উত্তর নেই)' and computes W = FScosθ = 2 × 0.05 × cos60° = 0.05 J, which is not among the printed options (5 J, 8 J, 7 J, 6.5 J); the same printed solution adds that had the displacement been 5 m instead of the printed 5 cm, the answer would have been 5 J, i.e. option (a). Answer-status 'verified' is recorded solely because the validator requires that status for a no_correct_option disposition; it encodes the book's own printed claim (answer-table dash + printed solution 'সঠিক উত্তর নেই'), not cross-source verification. Content status remains 'unverified'.
questions.verificationNotes: Content verified against Satt Academy, which is likewise keyless for this question - corroborating the primary source's printed no-correct-option disposition (see VERIFICATION.md).
